latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix pyro parameter nodes not showing up in graph of pyro deterministic nodes [bugfix] by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3378
* Support for deterministic dependent samples in PyroSample [enhancement] by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3376
* Equalize effect handler by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3375
* Update mappings to Sphnix documentation of other projects [bugfix] by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3383
* Fix models not rendering after application of the equalize effect handler by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3387
* Support PyTorch 2.4 in tests by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3389
* Update CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md by @Swarnim114 in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3391
* add copyright and license headers to various files by @andife in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3384
* Make Predictive work with the SplitReparam reparameterizer [bugfix] by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3388
* Support for transformed distributions, based on stacking or concatenation transforms, in SplitReparam by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3390
* Support observations that require broadcasting in SplitReparam by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3392
* Type annotate `pyro.util.py` by @ordabayevy in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3393
* Fix torch documentation link by @fehiepsi in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3396
* Use more numerically stable `log1p` in examples/scanvi/scanvi.py by @kit1980 in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3397
* Maintenance fixes by @ordabayevy in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3398
* Effect handler that conditions a model on sample sites having the same value by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3395
* Fix EqualizeMessenger type annotations by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3401
* Add batched calculation option to `energy_score_empirical` in order to reduce memory consumption by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3402
* Update example reference by @emmanuel-ferdman in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3403
* Fix `IndepMessenger.__iter__` type annotation by @ordabayevy in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3406
* fix autodetermination of plate device when running in a device contexf by @ilia-kats in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3405
* attempt to add sphinx_copybutton by @mjste in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3408
* Fixed norm const for SBVM by @OlaRonning in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3411
* Doc note and assert that sbvm conc <= 10k by @OlaRonning in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3412
* Reconciling expert opinions example by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3413
* Add a centered variance option to the ClippedAdam optimizer by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3415
* Update intro_long.ipynb by @yannickeich in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3420
* Use the new github template by @fehiepsi in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3421
* don't log to the root logger by @ilia-kats in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3422
* fix datapath bart data by @juanitorduz in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3425
* Use datasets from GitHub instead of CloudFront. by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3427
* Update CI to latest Ubuntu image. by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3428
* Update CI Python version to 3.12. by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3429
* Support changing the function used to calculate the euclidean distance in energy_score_empirical. by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3431
* Fix docker build by @BenZickel in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3432
* Fixes #3430 (serializing an easyguide corrupts it). by @BenZickel in https://g
